about: Regions on which a real Lean 4.27.0 (Init only, no Mathlib) ran the payload `#eval 7777` as a command, recorded by the Task 7 re-review of 2026-10-27 (differential fuzz: 560000 random regions placed after a tactic block, a declaration or a definition; the payload ran when a message was exactly `7777\n`). `missed` are the regions that the screen of c79681e or ec4817a accepted; `sample` is a seeded sample of the others, which both screens refused. structuralCheck must refuse every region of both lists, as the proof region.
recordedBy: the Task 7 re-review of fix round 3 (c79681e..ec4817a)
